_meta.source: Self-aggregated from the live AoE2 match backend (aoe-api.worldsedgelink.com)
_meta.method: Samples the top 2000 ranked 1v1 Random Map players, pulls recent completed matches (getRecentMatchHistory), filters matchtype_id=6 with exactly 2 players, dedupes by match id, and ACCUMULATES them into a local store. Each run accepts matches finished in the last 2 week(s) as new; the four views are tallied over the accumulated window (up to 12 weeks).
_meta.note: Live official backend data, accumulated locally over up to 12 weeks from periodic runs — larger sample than a single fetch, so civ-vs-civ/per-map cells are less noisy. Covers all played civs incl. the newest (Mapuche/Muisca/Tupi). Bias: top-of-ladder sample reflects high-level play; thin cells still flagged by `games`.
